text: The Trump administration will announce new fuel-economy standards, rolling back Biden-era rules that required ~50 mpg efficiency by 2031. Executives from Ford, GM, and Stellantis are attending. Oil-industry groups lobbied for the reversal, arguing the prior standards implicitly pushed a long-term shift toward EVs.

meta.note: Represents a deliberate directional reversal in national energy + automotive strategy; rewrites long-term national industrial rules.

text: ADP reports that private payrolls fell by 32,000, far below the +40,000 exception. Small businesses (fewer than 50 workers) suffered a massive 120,000 job loss — the steepest decline since March 2023. Larger businesses gained jobs, revealing a two-track economy. Wage growth slowed to 4.4%. The Fed enters its December 9-10 meeting with this as the final labor signal, amid internal policy disagreement.

meta.note: Informs national monetary policy architecture and reveals two-track economic stress.

text: Salesforce beat on adjusted EPS ($3.25 vs $2.86 expected), met on revenue (~$10.26B vs $10.27B expected; essentially flat), issued higher-than-expected Q4 revenue guidance ($11.13B-11.23B vs $10.9B expected). The stock rose ~2% after hours. Stock has underperformed badly in 2025 (-29% YTD) Concerns remain around generative AI cannibalizing Salesforce's own legacy CRM margins.

meta.note: Moderate-to-major signal, because it speaks to the structure of enterprise AI markets, exposes a deep product-line bifurcation, and confirms a long-horizon continuity target.
